TranslationContext: This file contains Unit Names for the Dwarf Hold Faction.

Translations.Comment: 砦 = fortress/hold. Emphasizes strongholds in mountain depths.
戦士 = warrior. Sturdy dwarven infantry with craftsmanship.
退役兵 = veteran/retired warrior. Experienced and battle-hardened troops.
鉱夫 = miner. Dwarves with dual mining and combat prowess.
弩兵 = crossbowman. Precise dwarf ranged warriors.
銃兵 = gunner/rifleman. Dwarven gunpowder specialists.
レンジャー = ranger (katakana). Scout and hunter units of dwarf holds.
砲 = cannon. Heavy dwarven siege artillery.
矢砲 = bolt thrower/arrow artillery. Mechanical ranged weapon.
石投機 = stone thrower/catapult. Siege weapon using stone projectiles.
狂戦士 = berserker/frenzied warrior. Elite aggressive dwarven warriors.
深淵 = deep/abyss, 守衛 = guard. Elite deep-hold defenders.
地獄火 = infernal fire, 砲 = cannon. Powerful fire-breathing artillery.
飛行兵器 = flying machine/weapon. Dwarven engineering marvel.
親方 = foreman/master. Leader of dwarven labor and combat forces.
隊長 = captain/commander. Officer leading ranger units.
技師 = engineer. Master of dwarven technological innovations.
